tasks.title: Clock source interfaces, mixer seam and fakes
tasks.brief: Read planning/plans/drivers.sync.clock.md and ADR-0125 (already written; keep in sync; do NOT edit brain/INDEX.md, put its line in the PR body). Create module drivers/clock. include/sonora/clock/clock_source.h: enum ClockSource{Internal,Adat,Spdif,WordClock}, enum ClockLock{Locked,Unlocked,Unknown}, ClockCaps, abstract ClockSourceControl{caps,select,selected,lock}. clock_mixer.h: abstract ClockMixer seam (enumerate elements, read/write enum and bool) and declaration of AlsaClockControl. clock_guard.h: class ClockGuard declaration (prepare(requested) with bounded poll count returning a result with a reason, confirm_unknown(device), poll(), lock_loss_count()). testing/fake_clock.h: FakeClockMixer, FakeClockControl. CMake drivers/clock/CMakeLists.txt: library sonora_clock from file(GLOB CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/*.cpp); one test executable and add_test clock_<stem> per tests/test_*.cpp, LABELS drivers; src/clock_version.cpp trivial so the library is never empty. Hook with ONE line in drivers/alsa/CMakeLists.txt: add_subdirectory(../clock clock). Do not edit root CMakeLists.txt or tools/module-deps.allow. Contract test tests/test_clock_contract.cpp exercising the fakes. No contracts/ or protocol change.
accept: tools/micro-build.sh builds drivers/clock and ctest -R clock_test_clock_contract passes; PR prints command and output
ADR-0125 keeps Context, Decision, Rationale, Consequences, Alternatives rejected, Unverified
no change to contracts/ or the protocol version

tasks.title: ClockGuard and ALSA clock control
tasks.brief: Define the declared classes. drivers/clock/src/clock_guard.cpp: ClockGuard per ADR-0125 section 4: refuse a missing source, a failed select, or still-unlocked after N polls (a count, no wall clock) with a reason; Unknown lock allowed only after confirm_unknown; poll() counts lock loss and never touches transport. drivers/clock/src/alsa_clock_control.cpp: AlsaClockControl over ClockMixer with an element-name table (UAC2 'Clock Source N Validity', 'Clock Selector', plus candidates). No libasound dependency here. Do not edit CMake or headers (ask the architect for an amendment). Control thread only; fail loudly.
accept: ctest -R clock passes through tools/build-slot.sh with the micro build
no silent fallback to Internal; lock loss never stops transport

tasks.title: Guard and ALSA control behaviour tests
tasks.brief: tests/test_clock_guard.cpp: unavailable source refused with reason, unlocked refused after bounded polls, Unknown needs confirmation, lock loss counted, no transport call, recovery after relock. tests/test_alsa_clock_control.cpp: element-name table, select/selected round trip, caps from FakeClockMixer, missing elements give caps with lock reporting false. No sleeps; CMake globs the files. List the ADR-0125 Unverified hardware questions in the PR for the researcher.
accept: ctest -R clock passes; command and output in the PR
